look_here_first: Look for fingerlike terminal flowering racemes with paired spikelets; inspect conspicuous ring of hairs at nodes, glumes and awns to distinguish other Old World bluestems.
photo_note: Temporary one-photo learner coverage. Keep until stronger diagnostic gallery coverage replaces or supplements it.
identification_caution: Photographed in New South Wales, Australia; this is an introduced/management comparison grass, NOT a Hays native planting recommendation.
